performance_case.causal_mechanism: At each existing DRA entry decision, only lagged realized volatility may identify periods in which expected return does not compensate path risk; reducing or scaling participation before entry could avoid disproportionate drawdown without changing exits, routes, regimes, sides, or Trading authority.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may assess only the external primary prior, causal distinctness and the proof needed for one later design audit. It cannot access outcomes or establish parameters, prediction, statistical significance, fee-adjusted PnL, drawdown, fills, turnover, costs, capacity, candidate readiness, OOS value, deployability, or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: If a later separately preregistered matched-capital experiment shows that causal volatility conditioning avoids uncompensated adverse paths without concentrating gains or sacrificing breadth, maximum drawdown may improve; this literature audit itself leaves drawdown MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Rejecting a transferable prior too early may delay a distinct risk-control mechanism, while accepting generic multi-asset in-sample evidence could waste a full experiment on unstable real-time estimation or relabel a closed range mechanism. The audit minimizes both errors before any implementation or outcome access.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Only a later independently frozen and validated matched-capital experiment could show positive fee-adjusted total PnL or drawdown improvement from volatility-conditioned DRA participation; the primary-literature prior audit has zero immediate performance effect.
